reachability.bound_to_loopback: The ports are bound to {{address}}: this server is not reachable from outside by design (for a tunnel or a proxy on this host). Nothing was sent.
reachability.docker_unavailable: Docker could not be asked which ports the container publishes ({{reason}}).
reachability.minecraft_offline: mcstatus.io got no answer from {{address}}. Check the firewall, the router's port forwarding and whether the server is fully started.
reachability.minecraft_online: mcstatus.io reached the Minecraft server at {{address}} from the internet.
reachability.no_public_address: No public address is set (Settings → Network, or on the server's edit page), so there is nothing to check from outside. Nothing was sent.
reachability.not_on_internet: The public address {{host}} has no public IPv4 address ({{addresses}}): the services check IPv4 internet addresses only. Nothing was sent.
reachability.not_running: The server is not running. Start it, wait until it is up, then check again.
reachability.port_not_published: The container does not publish {{port}}. It was probably created before the port was changed: recreate the container (edit page) so the change takes effect.
reachability.port_other_address: The container publishes {{port}} on {{actual}}, but the server is set to {{wanted}}: recreate the container (edit page) so the change takes effect.
reachability.probes_off: The check from outside is switched off. Set GSS_REACHABILITY_PROBES=on in the .env and restart the dashboard to offer it.
reachability.service_failed: {{service}} did not give a usable answer ({{reason}}). Try again later, or switch the service off.
reachability.service_off: Not checked: {{service}} is switched off in this installation.
reachability.state_unknown: Docker could not be asked whether the server is running ({{reason}}). Nothing was sent.
reachability.steam_listed: Steam lists this server at {{address}}: it runs and is announced at this address. Players connect directly, so a blocked port can still stop them.
reachability.steam_not_listed: Steam lists no server at {{address}} (other game ports at this address: {{others}}). A server set to public shows up a few minutes after its start; if it does not, players on the internet probably cannot see it either.
reachability.steam_not_listed_reforger: Steam lists no server at {{address}}. Arma Reforger announces its servers through Bohemia's own list, so this proves nothing either way.
reachability.tcp_closed: portchecker.io could not connect to {{address}}. Check the firewall and the router's port forwarding.
reachability.tcp_open: portchecker.io connected to {{address}} from the internet.
reachability.udp_not_checkable: UDP port {{port}} cannot be checked from outside: a UDP port that does not answer looks the same as a blocked one. Ask a player to connect.
reachability.unresolvable: The public address {{host}} does not resolve to an IPv4 address on this host ({{reason}}). Nothing was sent.
